title: CIRCULOOS circularity commons
description: Circular economy properties shared by every material data model under material/. Pull it into a material schema through allOf, the same way as GSMA-Commons.

batchNumber.description: Property. Lot/batch number of this quantity of material, for traceability back to its source.

quantity.description: Property. Unit: given by unitCode, e.g. KGM (kg), TNE (t), MTQ (m3), MTK (m2), C62 (pieces). Quantity of material in this lot.

refParentMaterial.description: Relationship. Material entities (lots) this material was produced from. Following the links back gives the material loop history.

refProcess.description: Relationship. Process or process event entity that produced this material.

refDigitalProductPassport.description: Relationship. Digital Product Passport (EU ESPR, Regulation (EU) 2024/1781) of the product this material comes from or belongs to.

refEnvironmentalFootprint.description: Relationship. environmental_footprint_indicator entity holding the environmental footprint (LCA indicators) of this material.

chainOfCustodyModel.description: Property. Chain of custody model (ISO 22095) behind the recycled or bio-based content claims of this material.

materialStatus.description: Property. Legal status of the material under the EU Waste Framework Directive 2008/98/EC: primary (virgin) material, by-product (Art. 5), waste, or material that has reached end-of-waste status (Art. 6). Receiving waste needs a waste permit.

wasteCode.description: Property. European List of Waste code (Commission Decision 2000/532/EC), e.g. 07 02 13 for waste plastic. A trailing * marks hazardous waste. Only when materialStatus is waste.

hazardous.description: Property. Whether the material is classified as hazardous.

endOfWasteReference.description: Property. The end-of-waste criteria (EU or national regulation, permit) under which the material stopped being waste.

recycledContent.description: Property. Unit: %. Total share of recycled material (ISO 14021).

preConsumerRecycledContent.description: Property. Unit: %. Share of recycled material recovered from manufacturing scrap, before reaching a consumer (ISO 14021).

postConsumerRecycledContent.description: Property. Unit: %. Share of recycled material recovered from products after their use (ISO 14021). The share counted by recycled content targets such as the PPWR, Regulation (EU) 2025/40.

biobasedContent.description: Property. Unit: %. Share of the material derived from biomass (EN 16785-1).

recycledTimes.description: Property. The number of times this material has already been through a recycling loop.

casNumber.description: Property. CAS registry number of the component, when it has one.

share.description: Property. Unit: %. Mass share of the component in the material.

composition.description: Property. Main components of the material and their mass shares.

casNumber.description: Property. CAS registry number of the substance.

ecNumber.description: Property. EC number of the substance.

concentration.description: Property. Unit: mg/kg. Measured concentration of the substance in the material.

regulation.description: Property. Regulation listing the substance: REACH candidate list (SVHC), REACH Annex XVII restriction (e.g. Cr(VI) in leather), EU POPs Regulation 2019/1021 (e.g. brominated flame retardants), or other.

substancesOfConcern.description: Property. Substances of concern present in the material, as required by the EU ESPR Digital Product Passport.

contaminationLevel.description: Property. Overall contamination level of the lot (foreign materials, dirt, labels, etc.).

qualityStandard.description: Property. Standard the material is characterised or traced against, e.g. EN 15343 (traceability of recycled plastics) or EN 15345 (PP recyclates).

suitableRecoveryRoutes.description: Property. Circular strategies (R-ladder) the material is suitable for. Used to match offers with demand.

scheme.description: Property. Certification scheme, e.g. ISCC PLUS, EuCertPlast, RecyClass, GRS, FSC, PEFC, LWG.

issuer.description: Property. Certification body that issued the certificate.

validUntil.description: Property. Expiry date of the certificate.
